written: 2026-11-22, before any return or score was computed; approved by the owner in chat the same day
question: With the market closed, which rule better sizes the index's one-sigma move from one close to the next: calendar days on the backup's vol curve (A, what the site does), or one VIX1D session (B)?
source_basis: Cboe VIX1D methodology v2.0 (26 Feb 2026): T in business minutes, 405 per session, 252 sessions a year; from 16:00 to 16:15 ET only the next expiration is used

inputs.columns: SPX, NDX: Yahoo ^GSPC / ^NDX daily close; VIX1D, VIX9D, VIX, VIX3M, VXN: Cboe daily close, percent

pairs.next_day: the next trading day n, last n = 2026-11-20
pairs.required: both closes of the index; all four VIX points on d, and VXN for both indexes; a pair missing any is dropped and counted

rules.A: sigma = iv(T) x sqrt(T / 365); T = calendar days from the close of d to the close of n (rth_close, ET); iv = gexsys.providers.occ.curve_iv on points (1 VIX1D, 9 VIX9D, 30 VIX, 93 VIX3M) / 100
rules.NDX: both x VXN / VIX of the same day

groups.primary: gap >= 3, neither d nor n an early close
groups.two_day: gap = 2, neither an early close, reported without a verdict
groups.early: d or n an early close, any gap, reported without a verdict

score: QLIKE = r^2 / sigma^2 + ln(sigma^2), lower is better; difference = A - B (positive: B better)

test.interval: 95% percentile interval of the mean difference, whole ISO weeks (of d) drawn with replacement, 10000 draws, the random.Random(20261121) generator restarted for each index and group; weeks sorted; each draw picks len(weeks) weeks with rng.randrange; mean = sum of differences / number of pairs; interval ends are sorted draws [249] and [9749]

b_better_only_if_all_hold_for_both_index: primary, later half: pairs in date order, the last ceil(n / 2): mean difference > 0
primary: B's share of |r| <= sigma is strictly closer to 0.682689 than A's
ordinary: the interval is not entirely below 0
otherwise: no edge found; rule A stays
reported_without_verdict: share inside 1 sigma with a Wilson 95% interval
before / after the VIX1D launch 2023-04-24 (d on or after)
known_before: the 2026-11-20 figures of both rules (no outcome)
